hard_requirements: Correct paired H/L lengths and identities
confidence_metric: Mean directed antibody-target chain-pair ipTM if available; otherwise global ipTM with an explicit fallback flag. Keep each model native score and units.
consensus: Median within-engine percentile rank across available models; exclude parent controls from candidate percentiles.
sort_order: Median cross-predictor binder pose RMSD ascending
interpretation: Exploratory computational ranking only. Contact/score rules are operational checks, not calibrated binding or experimental success thresholds.
